messages:
Jessica Li: Heads-up — NovaHealth is reporting their invoice for Feb shows a $4.2k charge that isn't on the dashboard. customer says dashboard total = $1,200 but invoice = $5,400.
Eva Chen: ack, I pulled their dashboard and invoices, seeing same. invoice has an extra plan-tier line and a large ‘misc tokens’ line.
Jessica Li: customer opened a ticket. They say usage timeline on dashboard looks normal — spike around 23:58 but not enough to explain +4k.
Raj (Platform): Billing-run logs show two charge runs for acct=nh-842 in the 00:00 UTC window: run_id=cr_20260301_a and cr_20260301_b. cr_b has same invoice_id as cr_a but bigger totals.
sam_oncall: billing-bot posted duplicate run: "charge-run started cr_20260301_b for nh-842 (retry after SQS timeout)" — looks like a retry created a second aggregation.
Billing-bot: charge-run cr_20260301_b state=completed, invoice_id=inv_9876 duplicate_of=inv_9875 (flag not set).
Eva Chen: so duplicate invoice created but dashboard aggregated tokens from the single aggregation job; invoice used the aggregated rows from both runs.
Mike (Finance): can we confirm token counts used in invoice? I need the raw metering rows for Feb 28 23:55-00:05 UTC for nh-842.
Raj (Platform): Running quick query on metering_events table to compare counts:
```
SELECT bucket, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE account_id='nh-842' AND ts >= '2026-02-28T23:50:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-01T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;
```
Raj (Platform): Results: two sets of aggregator_id values with overlapping ts. cr_a aggregated rows with aggregator_id=agg_453, cr_b used agg_453_copy (duplicate) — both got written to invoice_rows. Dashboard query dedupes on event_id while invoice job dedup logic keyed on aggregator_id.
Jessica Li: ah — different dedupe keys. dashboard -> event_id dedupe; invoice pipeline -> aggregator_id dedupe. retry produced new aggregator_id for same events, so invoice double-counted.
Eva Chen: customer-facing plan: apologize + remove duplicate line and issue corrected invoice. internal: fix invoice dedupe to also check event_id and add a migration to collapse duplicate aggregator ids.
sam_oncall: quick mitigation: run an emergency job to mark invoice_rows where event_id in (select event_id from duplicate_agg) as ignored and regenerate totals. I can run on staging first.
Mike (Finance): please include a note for accounting — we need corrected invoice and a credit for the duplicate amount.
Raj (Platform): repro steps for devs: 1) simulate SQS visibility timeout then re-enqueue the charge task 2) run charge-run twice -> observe two invoice_rows created with different aggregator_id but same event_ids. Attached sample commands:
```
# repro (local)
python infra/scripts/run_charge.py --account nh-842 --window "2026-02-28T23:50:00Z/2026-03-01T00:10:00Z" --force-retry
```
Raj (Platform): tentative patch: invoice pipeline will add event_id dedupe before writing invoice_rows and set duplicate_of when aggregator_id is new but event_ids overlap. I'll open PR.
Eva Chen: ETA on patch?
Raj (Platform): PR + tests later today, deploy tomorrow morning.
Jessica Li: action items: Eva to send customer note with temporary credit, Mike to prepare credit memos, Raj to ship patch and run migration, Sam to run staging repro and mitigation.
Eva Chen: I drafted message to NovaHealth, keeping it short and non-technical, asking for patience while we correct invoice.
Jessica Li: thanks. ping me when PR merged and when regen done.
Mike (Finance): noted, adding hold on collection for inv_9876 until corrected. :thumbsup:
sam_oncall: running staging repro now, will report back in ~10m.
sam_oncall: staging repro shows duplicate invoice rows present, mitigation script successfully marks duplicates when run with `--dry-run`.
Raj (Platform): PR opened: github.com/redwood/invoice/pull/412 — includes dedupe change and migration script.
Eva Chen: great. I'll update the customer after we run the regeneration in prod.
Jessica Li: closing loop later today after prod regen. :white_check_mark:
